findings.what: Criterion 5 fixes the row text at «4 из 5» for a count of 4.5 and puts the sentence «Не знаю» считается за половину in the same row under the label «Учтено ответов». The code floors the count (Math.floor), so a visitor with four answers and one «Не знаю» is told 'answers counted: 4 of 5' and then that «Не знаю» is half; the arithmetic the sentence invites gives 4.5, the number says 4. The same string «4 из 5» also appears for four answers plus one «Не знаю» (4.5) and for three answers plus two «Не знаю» (4.0); only the pips (aria-hidden) tell them apart, so a screen-reader user hears no half at all. It is honest enough for sighted users (the half pip is there, and the number understates rather than overstates), but not fully honest next to a sentence about halves, in a requirement whose purpose is an honest page.

findings.what: First-screen limit of criterion 6 (top edge between 0 and 844 at 390x844, design estimate y about 540, 844 being the test window WINDOWS[1]). Judged sound as a test limit: how.html above the block holds the banner, the header bar, an 84 px scene canvas with a caption, the eyebrow, h1 and pitch, and about 300 px of slack remain for a longer en or kk pitch. Weaknesses: it asks only that the top edge is inside the window, so a block whose heading is visible but whose rows are below the fold passes; and 844 px is the test window, not the visible height of a real phone browser (often 650 to 750 px). I did not run a browser (not allowed here), so the 540 figure is the design report's estimate and my judgement is by reading how.html and the CSS structure.
